name: Astragoth Ironhand
canonNotes: High Priest of Hashut in Zharr-Naggrund, so ancient his body is turning to stone, sustained by a great iron machine-body.
Master of daemonsmithing and the dark industry of the Chaos Dwarfs.
voiceNotes: Ancient, scornful and zealous; speaks of Hashut, fire and industry.
Views other races as slaves or fuel.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
